pr_title: privilege: fix show grants output for active roles + dynamic privs
pr_body:
### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/27213

Problem Summary:

`SHOW GRANTS` (for the current user) is expected to also summarize the grants which are inherited from active roles. This works correctly for static privileges, but was not implemented for dynamic privs.

### What is changed and how it works?

What's Changed:

The output of `SHOW GRANTS` now summarizes dynamic privileges inherited from assigned roles. This behavior improves compatibility with MySQL.


issue_context.title: show grants return wrong result.
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)
 Create user, role.

```sql
CREATE ROLE 'app_read';
create user test@'%';
GRANT SYSTEM_VARIABLES_ADMIN, PROCESS on *.* to 'app_read'@'%';
GRANT 'app_read' TO 'test'@'%';
SET DEFAULT ROLE app_read TO 'test'@'%';
```




<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)

```sql
▶ mysql -u test -h 127.0.0.1 -P 4000
(none)> show grants;
+---------------------------------------------------+
| Grants for test@%                                 |
+---------------------------------------------------+
| GRANT PROCESS ON *.* TO `test`@`%`                |
| GRANT SYSTEM_VARIABLES_ADMIN ON *.* TO `test`@`%` |
| GRANT `app_read`@`%` TO `test`@`%`                |
+---------------------------------------------------+
3 rows in set
Time: 0.008s
(none)> show grants for current_user();
+---------------------------------------------------+
| Grants for test@%                                 |
+---------------------------------------------------+
| GRANT PROCESS ON *.* TO `test`@`%`                |
| GRANT SYSTEM_VARIABLES_ADMIN ON *.* TO `test`@`%` |
| GRANT `app_read`@`%` TO `test`@`%`                |
+---------------------------------------------------+
3 rows in set

```

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)

```sql
▶ mysql -u test -h 127.0.0.1 -P 4000
(none)> show grants;
+------------------------------------+
| Grants for User                    |
+------------------------------------+
| GRANT PROCESS ON *.* TO 'test'@'%' |
| GRANT 'app_read'@'%' TO 'test'@'%' |
+------------------------------------+
2 rows in set
Time: 0.008s
(none)> show grants for current_user();
+------------------------------------+
| Grants for test@127.0.0.1          |
+------------------------------------+
| GRANT USAGE ON *.* TO 'test'@'%'   |
| GRANT 'app_read'@'%' TO 'test'@'%' |
```

review_comments:
I did move it to `fetchShowGrants`. Did you mean why did I move it?

I wanted to move the logic to one place because the handling of `SHOW GRANTS` versus `SHOW GRANTS FOR 'x'` is confusing. They are not really the same statement at all. The comment here is also incorrect, it looks like `show grants for current_user()` is the same as `show grants`.
Also add a test for `show grants for current_user();`
This should be fixed, PTAL again.

Look like the following test case is still not fixed:

```sql
CREATE ROLE 'app_read';
create user test@'%';
GRANT SYSTEM_VARIABLES_ADMIN, PROCESS on *.* to 'app_read'@'%';
GRANT 'app_read' TO 'test'@'%';
SET DEFAULT ROLE app_read TO 'test'@'%';
```
2.
```sql
▶ mysql -u test -h 127.0.0.1 -P 4000
(none)> show grants for current_user();  -- the following result is not expected.
+------------------------------------+
| Grants for test@127.0.0.1          |
+------------------------------------+
| GRANT USAGE ON *.* TO 'test'@'%'   |
| GRANT 'app_read'@'%' TO 'test'@'%' |
+------------------------------------+
2 rows in set
Time: 0.009s
(none)> show grants;
+---------------------------------------------------+
| Grants for User                                   |
+---------------------------------------------------+
| GRANT PROCESS ON *.* TO 'test'@'%'                |
| GRANT 'app_read'@'%' TO 'test'@'%'                |
| GRANT SYSTEM_VARIABLES_ADMIN ON *.* TO 'test'@'%' |
+---------------------------------------------------+

```

You're right! [This comment](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/dfe9acfa43237ceadab933420e4db20c6ad0c709/executor/builder.go#L745-L746) led me astray, but I've fixed it so that `SHOW GRANTS` and `SHOW GRANTS FOR CURRENT_USER()` should be the same now.
